per_row.question: Am I eligible for the education budget?
per_row.reply:
As a contractor, you are not eligible for the education budget, as it is not provided for contractors according to the benefits policy. This applies regardless of whether you have passed a probation period, which is not applicable to contractors in your case. Therefore, you will not receive any education budget allocation.

Sources: [benefits-policy §1.1], [benefits-policy §4.1]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly states that contractors are not eligible for the education budget, matching the gold answer's main point.

per_row.question: Can I get the home office allowance?
per_row.reply:
As a part-time employee in the Lviv office, you are not eligible for the home office allowance because it is only available to fully remote employees. Office-based employees working in hybrid mode do not qualify for this allowance, as stated in the Equipment Policy [equipment-policy §3.2].

Sources: [equipment-policy §3.1]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly states that the user is not eligible for the home office allowance because they are office-based and the allowance is only for fully remote employees.

per_row.question: Do I need my team lead's agreement to work from home two days a week?
per_row.reply: Yes, you need your team lead's agreement to work from home two days a week. As an office-based employee, you may work remotely up to 3 days per week, but this requires agreement with your team lead according to the Remote Work Policy [remote-work-policy §1.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer fully matches the gold answer by confirming the need for team lead agreement and correctly stating the maximum number of remote days per week.

per_row.question: What happens to the vacation days above the carry-over limit that I don't use by the end of the year?
per_row.reply:
Any vacation days you have above the carry-over limit of 5 days will expire on December 31. Therefore, if you do not use those excess days by the end of the year, you will lose them.

Sources: [leave-policy §3.4]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer accurately states that vacation days above the 5-day carry-over limit expire on December 31st, which fully matches the gold answer.

per_row.question: Can I take my wedding leave two months after the wedding?
per_row.reply: You cannot take your wedding leave two months after the wedding. According to the policy, special leave for your wedding must be taken within 30 days of the event [leave-policy §4.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate correctly states that the leave cannot be taken two months after the wedding and provides the correct timeframe of 30 days from the event.

per_row.question: Do I have to tell my team lead when I call in sick?
per_row.reply: Yes, you need to inform your team lead in the team channel as early as possible on the first day of your illness, in addition to registering your sick days. This is outlined in the Sick Leave Policy [sick-leave-policy §3.1].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer fully matches the gold answer, providing all the required information without any contradictions.

per_row.question: Is alcohol at a client dinner reimbursed?
per_row.reply:
Alcohol at a client dinner can be reimbursed, but only if the meal has been approved in advance by your team lead. Additionally, there is a limit of 40 USD per person for these client meals, which includes any alcohol consumed during the meal as long as it is part of the approved expenses. Please ensure you have the necessary approval and receipts for reimbursement.

Sources: [expense-reimbursement-policy §1.3], [expense-reimbursement-policy §5.1], [expense-reimbursement-policy §1.2]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly states that alcohol is reimbursed only at approved client meals, which aligns with the gold answer. It also adds extra details about the approval process and a spending limit, which do not contradict the gold answer.

per_row.question: Who pays if I accidentally break my laptop?
per_row.reply: If you accidentally break your laptop, the repair costs will be covered by the company. However, if there is repeated damage due to negligence, you may be partially charged after a review by HR [equipment-policy §2.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer fully matches the gold answer and adds a relevant, non-contradictory detail about repeated damage due to negligence.

per_row.question: When will my probation review happen and who takes part?
per_row.reply: Your probation review will happen near the end of your 3-month probation period, which means it will take place around January 15, 2027. The review meeting will be conducted by your team lead and HR, and the outcome will be recorded as passed, extended, or not passed [onboarding-policy §3.1][onboarding-policy §3.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly identifies the timing of the review (near the end of probation) and the participants (team lead and HR). It also adds extra correct details about the probation length and possible outcomes.

per_row.question: If the person I recommended joins as a contractor, do I still get the referral bonus?
per_row.reply:
Yes, you will receive a referral bonus of **1,000 USD** after the contractor you recommended has completed **3 months of cooperation** with the company. This applies to contractor hires as stated in the referral program policy.

Sources: [internal-requests-policy §3.1]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly states that a bonus is given after 3 months of cooperation, which fully matches the gold answer.

per_row.question: During which hours do I have to be available for meetings?
per_row.reply:
You need to be available for meetings during core hours, which are from **11:00 to 16:00 Kyiv time**. This applies to all employees, regardless of work format.

Sources: [remote-work-policy §1.3]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly identifies the core hours and time zone for meeting availability, matching the gold answer exactly.

per_row.question: Will my manager find out that I see the company psychologist?
per_row.reply: Your manager will not find out that you see the company psychologist, as the company does not receive any information about who used the sessions or what was discussed. This confidentiality is guaranteed under the benefits policy regarding psychological support [benefits-policy §5.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer fully matches the gold answer by stating that the manager will not find out and providing the correct reason for confidentiality.
